    About Jyotish Kundli

    Jyotish Kundli is a free Vedic astrology (Jyotish) birth chart generator. Enter your date, time and place of birth to get your Lagna, Rashi, Nakshatra and planetary positions using the Lahiri ayanamsa and whole-sign houses.

    • Lagna and Navamsa charts, plus every divisional chart from D1 to D60, in North and South Indian styles
    • Vimshottari and Yogini Dasha with Antardasha dates and a lifetime outlook timeline
    • Shadbala planetary strength with percentages, and Sarvashtakavarga and Bhinnashtakavarga charts
    • Reports: Kundli analysis, marriage compatibility (Ashtakoota), career and finance, numerology and a yearly horoscope with a Varsha chart
    • Panchang, yogas and doshas (Manglik, Kaal Sarp, Gajakesari and more), current transits and Sade Sati

    Marriage matching uses the Ashtakoota tables as published by common sources: Varna by Moon sign; Vashya and Gana read bride-by-groom; Tara by nakshatra count; Yoni simplified to same animal 4, sworn enemies 0, others 2; Graha Maitri by natural friendship; Bhakoot 2/12, 5/9 and 6/8 score 0; Nadi same scores 0. Sources differ slightly on Vashya, Gana direction and Yoni, so scores can differ from other calculators.

    Your chart, dashas, strengths and transits are calculated in your browser and your birth details are not sent anywhere for them. Only when you open a Report (Reports tab) are the birth details sent over HTTPS to this site's server to build it; they are processed in memory and not stored. A place name you type is looked up to find coordinates. Results are for learning and reflection, not professional advice.
    Charts are calculated in your browser. For the Reports tab only, birth details are sent securely to the server to build the report, processed in memory and not stored. When you search for a place, only the place name you type is sent to Open-Meteo's free geocoding service. Planetary positions are accurate to a fraction of a degree — verify against a professional ephemeris before relying on them. For reflection and entertainment, not professional advice.
